select timer_version as version,
    (select to_jsonb(a) || jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'ziel_id',ziel_id::text,'kunde_id',kunde_id::text,'konto_id',konto_id::text,'fassung',fassung::text) from zeitabschnitt a where ende is null) as aktiv,
    (select jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'art',art,'zielId',ziel_id::text,'kundeId',kunde_id::text,'seit',ende)
     from zeitabschnitt where id=konto.pause_abschnitt_id) as pause from konto

select $1::date::timestamp at time zone zeitzone as von,
      ($2::date+1)::timestamp at time zone zeitzone as bis from konto

select h.*,case
  when storniert and uebertragene_fassung is not null and not storno_bestaetigt then 'Storno offen'
  when storniert then 'Storniert'
  when ende is null then 'Läuft'
  when uebertragene_fassung is not null and (stand is distinct from uebertragener_stand or pruefen) then 'Erneut prüfen'
  when art='vorlaeufig' then 'Zuordnen'
  when pruefen then 'Zeit prüfen'
  when not abrechenbar then 'Nicht abrechenbar'
  when btrim(leistungstext)='' then 'Leistungstext fehlt'
  when uebertragene_fassung is null then 'Bereit'
  else 'Übertragen' end as status from (select a.id,a.art,a.beginn,a.ende,a.ziel_id,a.kunde_id,a.fassung,a.abrechenbar,a.pruefen,
  a.storniert,a.storno_bestaetigt,a.leistungstext,a.uebertragene_fassung,a.uebertragener_stand,
  k.name as kunde,z.bezeichnung as ziel,z.art as zielart,coalesce(p.bezeichnung,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.bezeichnung end) as projekt,
  (a.beginn at time zone u.zeitzone)::date::text as tag,
  extract(epoch from (a.ende-a.beginn))::bigint/60 as minuten,
  jsonb_build_object('beginn',a.beginn,'ende',a.ende,'kunde',k.name,'ziel',z.bezeichnung,'zielart',z.art,
    'kunde_id',k.id::text,'ziel_id',z.id::text,'projekt_id',coalesce(p.id,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.id end)::text,
    'projekt',coalesce(p.bezeichnung,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.bezeichnung end),
    'leistungstext',a.leistungstext,'abrechenbar',a.abrechenbar,
    'stunden',round(extract(epoch from (a.ende-a.beginn))/3600,u.nachkommastellen)::text) as stand
  from zeitabschnitt a join konto u on u.id=a.konto_id
  left join kunde k on (k.konto_id,k.id)=(a.konto_id,a.kunde_id)
  left join buchungsziel z on (z.konto_id,z.id)=(a.konto_id,a.ziel_id)
  left join buchungsziel p on (p.konto_id,p.id)=(z.konto_id,z.projekt_id)) h where beginn < $2::timestamptz
 and (ende > $1::timestamptz or ende is null or (ende=beginn and beginn >= $1::timestamptz)) order by beginn desc,id desc

Plans.Recheck Cond: (((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende > '2026-11-17 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) OR ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende IS NULL)) OR ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (beginn >= '2026-11-17 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (beginn < '2026-11-18 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ende = beginn)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (beginn >= '2026-11-17 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (beginn < '2026-11-18 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

select (t-extract(isodow from t)::int+1)::text as von,
 (t-extract(isodow from t)::int+7)::text as bis,zeitzone from (select $1::date t) x,konto

select $1::date::timestamp at time zone zeitzone as von,
      ($2::date+1)::timestamp at time zone zeitzone as bis from konto

with bestand as materialized (
 select konto_id,kunde_id,ziel_id,beginn,ende,abrechenbar from zeitabschnitt
 where beginn < $3::timestamptz and (ende > $2::timestamptz or ende is null) and not storniert),
 tage as (select $1::date+i as tag from generate_series(0,6) i),
 grenzen as (select tag,tag::timestamp at time zone k.zeitzone as von,(tag+1)::timestamp at time zone k.zeitzone as bis from tage,konto k),
 teile as (select g.tag,k.name as kunde,coalesce(p.bezeichnung,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.bezeichnung end) as projekt,a.abrechenbar,
 greatest(0,extract(epoch from(least(coalesce(a.ende,date_trunc('minute',clock_timestamp())),g.bis)-greatest(a.beginn,g.von)))/60)::int as minuten
 from grenzen g join bestand a on a.beginn<g.bis
 and (a.ende>g.von or (a.ende is null and date_trunc('minute',clock_timestamp())>g.von))
 left join kunde k on (k.konto_id,k.id)=(a.konto_id,a.kunde_id)
 left join buchungsziel z on (z.konto_id,z.id)=(a.konto_id,a.ziel_id)
 left join buchungsziel p on (p.konto_id,p.id)=(z.konto_id,z.projekt_id))
 select tag::text,kunde,projekt,sum(minuten)::int as minuten,
 coalesce(sum(minuten) filter(where abrechenbar),0)::int as abrechenbar from teile
 group by tag,kunde,projekt order by tag,kunde nulls last,projekt nulls last

Plans.Recheck Cond: (((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende > '2026-11-15 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) OR ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende IS NULL)))
Plans.Filter: ((NOT storniert) AND (beginn < '2026-11-22 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint))

Plans.Join Filter: ((a.beginn < (((('2026-11-16'::date + i.i) + 1))::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE k_1.zeitzone)) AND ((a.ende > ((('2026-11-16'::date + i.i))::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE k_1.zeitzone)) OR ((a.ende IS NULL) AND (date_trunc('minute'::text, clock_timestamp()) > ((('2026-11-16'::date + i.i))::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE k_1.zeitzone)))))

select count(*)::int as anzahl from (select h.*,case
  when storniert and uebertragene_fassung is not null and not storno_bestaetigt then 'Storno offen'
  when storniert then 'Storniert'
  when ende is null then 'Läuft'
  when uebertragene_fassung is not null and (stand is distinct from uebertragener_stand or pruefen) then 'Erneut prüfen'
  when art='vorlaeufig' then 'Zuordnen'
  when pruefen then 'Zeit prüfen'
  when not abrechenbar then 'Nicht abrechenbar'
  when btrim(leistungstext)='' then 'Leistungstext fehlt'
  when uebertragene_fassung is null then 'Bereit'
  else 'Übertragen' end as status from (select a.id,a.art,a.beginn,a.ende,a.ziel_id,a.kunde_id,a.fassung,a.abrechenbar,a.pruefen,
  a.storniert,a.storno_bestaetigt,a.leistungstext,a.uebertragene_fassung,a.uebertragener_stand,
  k.name as kunde,z.bezeichnung as ziel,z.art as zielart,coalesce(p.bezeichnung,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.bezeichnung end) as projekt,
  (a.beginn at time zone u.zeitzone)::date::text as tag,
  extract(epoch from (a.ende-a.beginn))::bigint/60 as minuten,
  jsonb_build_object('beginn',a.beginn,'ende',a.ende,'kunde',k.name,'ziel',z.bezeichnung,'zielart',z.art,
    'kunde_id',k.id::text,'ziel_id',z.id::text,'projekt_id',coalesce(p.id,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.id end)::text,
    'projekt',coalesce(p.bezeichnung,case when z.art='Projekt' then z.bezeichnung end),
    'leistungstext',a.leistungstext,'abrechenbar',a.abrechenbar,
    'stunden',round(extract(epoch from (a.ende-a.beginn))/3600,u.nachkommastellen)::text) as stand
  from zeitabschnitt a join konto u on u.id=a.konto_id
  left join kunde k on (k.konto_id,k.id)=(a.konto_id,a.kunde_id)
  left join buchungsziel z on (z.konto_id,z.id)=(a.konto_id,a.ziel_id)
  left join buchungsziel p on (p.konto_id,p.id)=(z.konto_id,z.projekt_id)) h) s
 where ende is not null and status in ('Storno offen','Erneut prüfen','Zuordnen','Zeit prüfen','Leistungstext fehlt','Bereit')
 and beginn < $2::timestamptz and (ende > $1::timestamptz or (ende=beginn and beginn >= $1::timestamptz))

Plans.Filter: (CASE WHEN (a.storniert AND (a.uebertragene_fassung IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT a.storno_bestaetigt)) THEN 'Storno offen'::text WHEN a.storniert THEN 'Storniert'::text WHEN (a.ende IS NULL) THEN 'Läuft'::text WHEN ((a.uebertragene_fassung IS NOT NULL) AND ((jsonb_build_object('beginn', a.beginn, 'ende', a.ende, 'kunde', k.name, 'ziel', z.bezeichnung, 'zielart', z.art, 'kunde_id', (k.id)::text, 'ziel_id', (z.id)::text, 'projekt_id', (COALESCE(p.id, CASE WHEN (z.art = 'Projekt'::text) THEN z.id ELSE NULL::bigint END))::text, 'projekt', COALESCE(p.bezeichnung, CASE WHEN (z.art = 'Projekt'::text) THEN z.bezeichnung ELSE NULL::text END), 'leistungstext', a.leistungstext, 'abrechenbar', a.abrechenbar, 'stunden', (round((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (a.ende - a.beginn)) / '3600'::numeric), u.nachkommastellen))::text) IS DISTINCT FROM a.uebertragener_stand) OR a.pruefen)) THEN 'Erneut prüfen'::text WHEN (a.art = 'vorlaeufig'::text) THEN 'Zuordnen'::text WHEN a.pruefen THEN 'Zeit prüfen'::text WHEN (NOT a.abrechenbar) THEN 'Nicht abrechenbar'::text WHEN (btrim(a.leistungstext) = ''::text) THEN 'Leistungstext fehlt'::text WHEN (a.uebertragene_fassung IS NULL) THEN 'Bereit'::text ELSE 'Übertragen'::text END = ANY ('{"Storno offen","Erneut prüfen",Zuordnen,"Zeit prüfen","Leistungstext fehlt",Bereit}'::text[]))

Plans.Recheck Cond: (((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende > '2026-11-15 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ende IS NOT NULL)) OR ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (beginn >= '2026-11-15 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (beginn < '2026-11-22 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ende = beginn)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (ende > '2026-11-15 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ende IS NOT NULL))

((konto_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.konto_id'::text, true), ''::text))::bigint) AND (beginn >= '2026-11-15 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (beginn < '2026-11-22 23:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))
